description: Blocked roads in Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands after Hurricane Maria is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by FEMA (assessment published by FEMA; deposited on HydroShare). This assessment of blocked roads in the days after Hurricane Maria made landfall was conducted and published by FEMA. The extent of the blocked roads assessment included the affected zones in Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands. Please refer to the FEMA data services for the original data files (published 2017-09-26) and methodology: [. Coverage: Puerto Rico, United States. The resource was created 2018-05-24 and last updated 2026-02-13; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
